Drop-In Court Queue

Enter the teams and arrival order, then append start, finish, join and leave events in order; press “Update court queue” to see who is on court, who stays, who waits and the next pair.

Reload: if the page failed to initialize, reload it here.

Teams

One team per line, 2–12 teams. A name is 1–24 characters, starting with a letter or digit.

One known team per line, in arrival order. May be empty.

Integer 1–3, default 2. A winner who reaches the cap returns to the end of the queue.

Events (in the order they happened)

A start needs two teams; a finish takes the winner, blank for a draw. Join adds a late team to the queue; leave removes a waiting or staying team.

The sample is fixed fake data (A wins twice and hits the cap); press “Update court queue” to calculate it.
